Bill.BriefDescription: Evaluating the seminary building at Saint Edward state park.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to gathering information about Saint Edward statepark; creating new sections; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that Saint Edwardstate park is an important, unique, and endangered feature of the stateparks system. Saint Edward state park features over three hundredacres of land and three thousand feet of freshwater shoreline alongLake Washington. Most notably, Saint Edward state park is home to theSaint Edward seminary building, which was constructed in 1931 andserved as a seminary until 1977. The historic seminary building wasoperated by the Roman Catholic archdiocese of Seattle until itstransfer to the Washington state parks and recreation commission in the1970s. The seminary building at Saint Edward state park has beenlisted on the Washington heritage register by the department ofarcheology and historic preservation. (2) The legislature further finds that the seminary building atSaint Edward state park is a unique feature of the park that should betreasured and maintained by the parks and recreation commission longinto the future. However, the current status of the seminary building p. 1 HB 1172is unsatisfactory. The seminary's current state of disrepair blocksfree public access to the historic building and brings into doubt thefuture of the building's stability. (3) The legislature further finds that the state parks andrecreation commission should give the Saint Edward seminary building atop priority in terms of attention and funding. The state parks andrecreation commission has been entrusted with a building of greathistorical significance and owes to Washington's future citizens theduty of maintaining and restoring the structure for their enjoyment andenrichment.

(1) The state parks and recreationcommission shall conduct or commission a full engineering andarchitectural evaluation of the seminary building at Saint Edward statepark. The evaluation must, at a minimum: (a) Identify the repairs necessary immediately to stop or slow thefurther deterioration of the seminary building; (b) Identify the extent of the repairs necessary to maintain thebasic level of public safety expected in a building open to the public;and (c) Identify which additional repairs or restoration would benecessary for the seminary building to be used for various purposesbeyond mere recreational occupancy. (2) The evaluation conducted under this section must also identifythe estimated costs associated with all repairs or restoration. (3) The evaluation required by this section must be completed andreported to the appropriate committees of the legislature by January 1,2008.
